data.next: Ask whether the accepted answer is the best answer or merely the accepted one: read the rows every arm in E181 missed and classify them. One reader, no new fetch, and it is the only explanation the EVID population has left - if the missed rows are contestable resolutions, the gap is a disagreement about answers and no context pipeline will close it.
data.summary: E181 measured the mechanism F136 left open: does supplying the missing fact close the 0.4000 evidence gap? Four paired arms on E177's own EVID population, all answered and scored in one session with leak assertions on every input. Question alone 0.5000, + the extracted missing fact 0.5714, + the entire comment thread 0.6429, placebo 0.4000. Every paired comparison is null (exact McNemar p = 1.0) and floor-vs-whole-thread is 0 rows for and 2 against, so neither supplying the fact nor pasting the thread moves the rate: the elicitation route closes (D119, F139) and F136's population gap is left standing but unexplained. Two numbers survive the kill: an extracted fact is 6.7% of the thread's tokens, and the comments name the deciding fact on 14/30 = 0.4667 with 10 of 16 nulls carrying the remedy itself - so the round trip runs to the solution, not to the fact. G4 fired (the same reader disagreed with itself on 4 of 10 of E177's answers one day later), so no absolute level here is comparable with E177's. K1 fired, so no gate is evaluated and every arm is labelled exploratory. Repaired two evidence defects found on the way: .gitignore could not track EXPERIMENTS/*/raw/*.jsonl at all (109 files, 199 MB untracked, while two protocols promise an auditable capture) and E178's capture holds each comment_id up to three times.
